syllabus_topics: Definition and examples of vector spaces
Kernel and image of a linear transformation
Solution space of a linear equation
Examples of applications (e.g., systems of linear ordinary differential equations with constant coefficients, stability of linear dynamic systems, Markov chains, PageRank algorithm)
Singular value decomposition of a transformation between Euclidean spaces
assessment_rules: The final grade for the 1st period (NF1) is (T1+T2+T3)/3, rounded to units. Any test grade will be 0 if the student does not attend the respective test. A voluntary recovery exam can be taken to improve a single test grade (T1, T2, or T3) or the NF1 grade, substituting the original grade if it improves. The final grade NF = max(NF1, NF2, E), rounded to units, where NF2 is the grade after recovering one test and E is the grade after recovering NF1. Approval requires NF>=10. An optional oral exam is available for students with NF > 17, where the final grade will be between 17 and 20, or 17 if they do not attend.
